content.value_statement: Agent quality can drift when teams change prompts without clear measurements. This skill provides a structured workflow for baseline metrics, prompt improvements, testing, rollout, and monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Defines baseline metrics for task success, accuracy, latency, token use, and satisfaction.
Classifies agent failure modes by instruction errors, context loss, tool misuse, and constraints.
Guides prompt improvements using examples, role refinement, self-checks, and output format tuning.
Plans A/B tests with representative scenarios, evaluation metrics, and human review rubrics.
Describes staged rollout, rollback triggers, monitoring, and post-deployment review cycles.
limitations: Requires an existing agent with measurable activity and feedback.
Does not build a new agent architecture from scratch.
Does not provide executable evaluation tooling or automated dashboards.
Requires users to supply real metrics, examples, and test cases.

use_cases.title: Stabilize a Production Agent
use_cases.description: Use baseline metrics, regression tests, and rollback triggers before changing prompts in production.

use_cases.title: Improve Support Quality
use_cases.description: Analyze corrections, follow-up questions, and failed answers to improve a customer support agent.

use_cases.title: Compare Prompt Variants
use_cases.description: Run structured A/B tests that compare accuracy, latency, cost, and user preference.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Baseline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit of current agent performance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to define baseline metrics for my existing agent. Focus on success rate, corrections, latency, and token use.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to classify failures from these examples. Group issues by instructions, tools, context, format, and safety constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Design Prompt Improvements
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to propose prompt changes, example updates, self-checks, and output format improvements for these recurring failures.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Controlled Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design an A/B test, success criteria, rollout stages, monitoring checks, and rollback triggers for this agent update.

output_examples.input: A support agent has more retries and inconsistent refund answers.
output_examples.output: A baseline plan with correction metrics, failure categories, prompt fixes, test cases, and rollout controls.

output_examples.input: Two prompt versions need comparison before production deployment.
output_examples.output: An A/B test plan with sample size, evaluation metrics, human review criteria, and rollback thresholds.

output_examples.input: An internal coding agent misuses tools and loses context in long tasks.
output_examples.output: A diagnosis that separates tool selection issues, context decay, output format failures, and targeted prompt changes.

best_practices: Start with representative examples and measurable baseline metrics.
Validate each prompt change with regression tests before rollout.
Monitor quality, safety, latency, cost, and user feedback after release.
anti_patterns: Changing prompts without a baseline or success criteria.
Testing only happy path examples and ignoring known failures.
Deploying all traffic to a new agent version without rollback triggers.

faq.question: What does this skill optimize?
faq.answer: It optimizes existing agent behavior through metrics, failure analysis, prompt changes, validation, rollout, and monitoring.

faq.question: Does it create new agents?
faq.answer: No. It assumes an existing agent already has usage data, feedback, or test cases.

faq.question: Can it help with Claude and Codex workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow can guide agent improvement work in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code environments.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide recent agent outputs, failure examples, user corrections, metrics, prompt text, and deployment constraints.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It describes how to design tests and evaluations, but users must run or implement the tooling.

faq.question: How does it reduce rollout risk?
faq.answer: It recommends staged rollout, monitoring periods, clear success criteria, and rollback triggers.
